{{Quote|She's heading north in the prison corridor.|The Coruscant Guard to Commander Fox|<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was stationed at the [[Republic military base]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
After [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] escaped her cell after being mistakenly arrested for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], this Coruscant Guard and a couple of other troopers chased her through the military base into the north corridors. The trooper sealed the area and informed [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] of her direction.
